name: Software development
description: Nuxiva really programs: it creates projects (sites, Python apps, API services, Node and React apps), writes and reads files in a confined folder, runs tests and checks in isolation and publishes sites on the home network.
capabilities: Working starter projects: static site, Python, FastAPI, Node, React with Vite
Files confined to the project, no outside paths or symlinks
Tests and checks without network, with time, memory and process limits, only after confirmation
Real test results returned, never claimed without running them
Static sites published on the home network
